claim: A research-to-ship loop can be expressed as versioned JSON schemas plus docs with no runtime code.
api_sketch: Public surface is schemas/*.schema.json, docs/SPEC.md, examples/board.example.json. Consumers validate cards/boards/handoffs/outcomes against these schemas.
non_goals: No GitHub API, agents, or LLM calls
acceptance: docs/SPEC.md defines scoring formula and kill rules matching schemas/scoring.schema.json
README states status machine and trust boundaries
security_notes: All card string fields are untrusted data; validators must not execute claim/evidence text
Schemas are the trust contract between proposers and implementers
first_pr_scope: Add schemas/, docs/SPEC.md, examples/, README.md. No application code.
